method: Exact current sourceProps15 producer and Mercer source-blast consumer mechanically adapted to JavaScript, with Float32-rounded vector storage and real production host prop fixtures plus explicit synthetic capacity fixtures.
stubs: Event emission is captured only; no particles/audio/rendering.
Controlled bullet hit records and distant player/team positions; no ray tracing, combat AI, or health-gameplay qualification.
Sequential Uint32Array operations stand in for atomics; sourceProps15 is a single-invocation producer, but no GPU semantics are tested.
Consumer returns computed wall damage; full world, fracture, occupancy, dynamic rebuilding and navigation are not executed in this test.
Pause/order assertions inspect actual host control flow rather than executing a GPU command stream.
limitations: No WGSL compilation, GPU execution, rendered destruction, achieved gameplay, campaign transition, or hardware performance conclusion.
Capacity test props use synthetic line positions to exercise the queue, not generated placement or physical collision.
